title: a non-reference VVC frame that is output is fully released, returning its pooled side tables while the decoder still holds them
live_proof: the fix is an ANCESTOR of the pin, so the defect is absent from it: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 5c66a3ab51 n9.0.1` succeeds, and the fixed form is present verbatim at n9.0.1:libavcodec/vvc/refs.c:254 as `ref->flags = VVC_FRAME_FLAG_OUTPUT | VVC_FRAME_FLAG_SHORT_REF;`. The case re-introduces the reverse, as the other three in this corpus do. Checked against the backport trap as well: the cherry-pick probe is not what settles this one, because the fix is in by ancestry rather than by a pick
object: a VVC frame's per-frame side tables, tab_dmvr_mvf and rpl_tab, taken from their AVRefStructPools at refs.c:153 and :157
lifetime_ender: ff_vvc_unref_frame clears the frame's last flag, so the `if (!frame->flags)` branch at refs.c:53 runs av_refstruct_unref on both tables, returning them to pool->available_entries
shape: premature return to the pool / reuse / stale read
allocator_layer: AVRefStructPool (libavutil/refstruct.c), with the frame's planes on AVBufferPool alongside
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator: refstruct.c and buffer.c are upstream's, unreduced, and the pool's recycling is its own -- a release pushes the entry onto pool->available_entries (refstruct.c:230-231) and the next av_refstruct_pool_get pops the same one back (:258-261). Reduced is the consumer: ff_vvc_unref_frame's flag arithmetic is transcribed, the frame carries only the fields this defect touches, and no decoder is built. The triggering condition is written out rather than reached through a bitstream: a picture with ph_pic_output_flag set and ph_non_ref_pic_flag set, which is the combination the upstream message names
distinguishing: the only case in this corpus whose stale storage comes from AVRefStructPool rather than AVBufferPool, and the only one whose release is triggered by flag arithmetic rather than by a reference count reaching zero through a consumer's own unref

native-fix-differential.oracle: the buggy arm has the tables released and reissued at the same address, and reads the new owner's 0xCC; the fixed arm keeps VVC_FRAME_FLAG_SHORT_REF set so the release branch never runs and nothing is reissued
native-fix-differential.note: this pair differs by the upstream fix, not by protection

sublet-port.oracle: case.c unchanged against the Sublet port of FFmpeg's own pools (app port, FFAPP_POOL=sublet): the defect faults at an instruction case.c's line table puts on a line that dereferences the stale table pointer, before the verdict line; the fix completes with VERDICT FIXED
sublet-port.control: the same case.c and driver objects linked against upstream's pools (FFAPP_POOL=stock): the defect completes with VERDICT DEFECT-REPRODUCED, the fix with VERDICT FIXED

status: declared 2026-10-03, not yet run on any arm. The sublet-port predictions are registered in runners/sublet-port-expect.txt before the first build, as this corpus requires; nothing here claims an outcome
note: The arms left 'not written' are the ones this case cannot honestly carry yet: spatial and sublet need a probe case in ports/ffmpeg/buffer-pool (36-38 are taken by cases 0-2), and the PoisonCap and CheriBSD arms need platforms this host does not have. They are declared rather than omitted so the corpus's required_arms stay satisfied without any of them implying a result
